_doc: SP-20260718-003 D5 — the machine-readable lane contract for the security 3-lab panel (PRD R-6 / AC-7,8). Declares the binding `panel-3lab` profile and the degraded `panel-2family` floor, and per-lane the {provider, tool_id, shape} identity. This file is a CONTRACT VIEW, NOT a source of truth: lane identity DERIVES from passesOf('security-reviewer') (role-registry keystone) + providerToolId() (dispatch-agent) + support-matrix.json status. validatePanelManifest() (scripts/dispatch/panel-lanes.js) fail-CLOSES on ANY drift between this view and those three sources — so a hand-edit that diverges the manifest is a loud RED, never a silent false-green. Consumed by the D7 panelStatus reducer + the D8 attestation + the CLI-only panel-runner tooth in dispatch-review.js.
_single_source: Lab identity = passesOf('security-reviewer') primary/second_pass/third_pass (antigravity/openai/claude) mapped to tool-id via providerToolId(); lane STATUS = support-matrix.json rows. No 4th source. Adding/renaming a lab is a role-registry edit; this manifest is validated against it.

sunset.note: The agy (Antigravity) lab liveness is OPERATOR-OWNED: no live agy CLI/tier yet. Until one real agy `fallback:false` ledger record exists, the binding panel-3lab exit is BLOCKED-ON-OPERATOR, never GREEN. Tracked as ED-060; the ed060-sunset.js enforcer fails /scan:full once the sunset date passes unresolved.

panel-3lab._note: The BINDING Phase-1 panel exit. Every required lane must be alive + clean + attested on its contracted provider, with >=2 distinct provider families OBSERVED (not manifest-labelled). A down required lane (agy today) resolves BLOCKED-ON-OPERATOR — never a silent pass.

panel-2family._note: The DEGRADED interim floor while agy liveness is operator-owned (ED-060). Buildable work + the sprint's OWN meta-gauntlet run here (2-family: GPT + Claude). Passing panel-2family does NOT satisfy the binding panel-3lab exit.

gpt._role: GPT jailbreak lab — CLI subprocess (dispatch-agent.js). An in-process-agent resolution is a contract violation (silent Claude clone).

claude._role: The ONE legal in-process Claude lane — the ADR-0016 hunter (third_pass opus@max), summoned by e via the Agent tool + record-inprocess. Positive-identity-scoped: lane 'claude' AND provider 'claude'. A gpt/agy lane can NEVER assert this exemption.

agy._role: Gemini lab via Antigravity (the individual gemini CLI is sunset) — CLI subprocess. CONTRACTED but DOWN today (support-matrix agy-antigravity.status=down); a zero-record agy lane resolves BLOCKED, never a pass.
